about: Built-in cards whose reading (cards) or example reading (examples) differs from kuromoji's reading of the front, each checked by hand and kept because the card is right (kuromoji misreads counters, 日本, 何, 間, idioms and slang). tests/japaneseSeedContent.test.ts fails on a mismatch not listed here, and on an entry that no longer mismatches. Reviewed 2026-10-16.
